typed_finding_first.consequence: direction 4 option (a) in its strict same-domain form is UNDEFINED on committed bytes — the reference class is empty

pre_registered_rule.representation: the SAME deterministic stack as the r106 gate run: extract_core_mechanism (the novelty-statement-marker rule) + allenai/specter2_base proximity adapter, eval mode, cosine distance
pre_registered_rule.reference_class: the row's NEAREST PRIOR PROCESS NEIGHBORHOOD: nearest prior row -> its single-linkage cluster; clusters formed at t_c = the PRIOR CORPUS' OWN MEDIAN pairwise cosine distance (a derived, deterministic constant — recorded at cluster time, never hand-tuned)
pre_registered_rule.small_cluster_fallback: a cluster with <8 rows unions the next-nearest cluster until >=8 (typed in the record per row)

legs.margin_leg (unchanged): d_min > known_obvious_anchor_dist + 0.05 (the r100/r106 prereg margin, untouched)
legs.p95_domain_leg (option a, adapted): d_min(row, cluster) > p95(pairwise within the reference cluster)
legs.mad_z_leg (option b): z = (d_min - median(cluster pairwise)) / MAD(cluster pairwise) > 2.0 (the robust-outlier cut, pre-registered HERE at 2.0 before any verdict; the novel anchor's z is REPORTED, never used to set the cut)

pre_registered_rule.verdict_rule: novel iff margin_leg AND (p95_domain_leg OR mad_z_leg)
pre_registered_rule.determinism: sorted keys, rounded floats, no wall-clock in hashed inputs (Art. 15); the encoder cache is the committed models_cache path

acceptance_battery.self_match_probes: 5 prior rows' own extracted mechanisms fed back as evaluated rows — ALL must FAIL (0 false passes)
acceptance_battery.v15_rows: the 30 burned rows reported as a distribution (informational; no gold labels — the battery is the acceptance, not the v15 verdicts)

anti_tuning: this prereg lands on the queue BEFORE the recompute runs; any post-hoc change to t_c, k_z, the probe set, or the verdict rule is a typed finding
